arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
scratch=$(mktemp -d /tmp/leads-group-preflight.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$scratch"' EXIT
git -c credential.helper= clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$scratch/repo"
cd "$scratch/repo"
echo SOURCE_SHA $(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo SOURCE_FILES
find scripts tests docs -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | grep -E 'discovery|group|policy|runtime|bootstrap|readme' | head -70
echo SOURCE_DISCOVERY_SEGMENT
sed -n '1,115p' scripts/public_group_discovery.py
echo SOURCE_RUNTIME_DISCOVERY
sed -n '365,460p' scripts/safe_runtime.py
echo SOURCE_POLICY_JOIN
sed -n '208,272p' scripts/operation_policy.py
echo MATCHING_TESTS
grep -R -n -E 'assigned_group_account|joined_groups|pending_group_actions|GROUP_JOINS|group_daily_limit|discover_daily|groups_joined|load_group_allowlist' tests/ | head -100
echo PREFLIGHT_COMPLETED
